subject.title: refactor: own model discovery by runtime lifecycle

question: Should the released Plugin SDK keep `loadModelCatalog` as the long-term compatibility wrapper around lifecycle-owned snapshots, or should maintainers require a narrower/deprecation-only public contract before landing this refactor?
rationale: The code can preserve source compatibility while materially changing the ownership and timing semantics external plugins observe; repository policy requires maintainer-visible direction for plugin API additions and compatibility boundaries.

options.title: Approve the compatibility wrapper
options.body: Land the prepared snapshot APIs with `loadModelCatalog` retained as the documented deprecated bridge, including its nonblocking cache-only semantics.

options.title: Narrow the public surface first
options.body: Keep the lifecycle implementation but revise the SDK exports and deprecation plan before merge so external plugin behavior has one clearly supported contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the compatibility wrapper
recommendation.body: Land the prepared snapshot APIs with `loadModelCatalog` retained as the documented deprecated bridge, including its nonblocking cache-only semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the current lifecycle and SDK compatibility design and can route the requested maintainer decision to the appropriate code owners.
